description: Implementation of ProductOptionDao for accessing product option data, including methods for listing, retrieving by ID, name, code, and read-only status, with database queries using QueryDSL.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductOption entity, providing data access methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptions for a given store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions matching a name pattern for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves read-only ProductOptions for a store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductOption entity, handling persistence.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by its code for a specific store.
